primary_estimand.name: mean_permutation_mapping_reorganisation
primary_estimand.definition: Mean over 24 frozen permutations and 4 profiles of FUTURE_REASSIGNED action×profile surface along the permutation minus STATIC_CONTROL action×profile surface along identity.

choice_model.response: one chosen action from four actions per choice set

hypotheses.H0: STATIC_CONTROL and FUTURE_REASSIGNED have identical action×profile response surfaces; primary estimand equals 0.
hypotheses.H1: FUTURE_REASSIGNED surface contains a controlled permutation-following reorganisation relative to STATIC_CONTROL; primary estimand is non-zero.

effect_schedule.interpretation: additive logit displacement applied only to the permutation-aligned FUTURE_REASSIGNED action×profile cell relative to the STATIC identity surface

null_control: Under H0 delta=0 and all condition-specific action×profile surface differences are zero.
randomisation: Use frozen balanced allocation and frozen 24-permutation table; DGP seed is supplied by execution manifest, never chosen adaptively.
missingness: none in the DGP; invalid outputs are execution-layer failures, not DGP missingness.
audit_requirements: algebraic proof that H0 produces primary estimand 0
algebraic proof that delta contributes to the primary estimand
verify nuisance effects cancel from the primary contrast
verify probabilities sum to 1 for every choice set
verify no value/utility/reward/performance signal is introduced as an outcome
verify deterministic reproducibility for fixed seed
next_action: Build and run a DGP-only audit; do not execute the scientific Monte Carlo.
